data.desc: e.l.f. Brands includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair, all part of e.l.f. Beauty (NYSE: ELF). e.l.f. is on a mission to make the best of beauty accessible to every eye, lip and face through positivity, inclusivity and accessibility. e.l.f.'s superpowers are creating premium-quality, vegan and e.l.f. clean products that are universally appealing at affordable prices. All products are double-certified by Leaping Bunny and PETA as cruelty-free. e.l.f. is proud to have products made in Fair Trade Certified facilities.
